thread:
Noah: Quick thread to follow up on the security section from today's all-hands. I captured customer asks, will assign owners.

Priya: Thanks. Main customer ask: exact ETA for SOC2 Type II for hosted API. They want something to include in their procurement docs.

Yara: Short update: control evidence window started in Feb; plan is to ship the hosted SOC2 Type II report by end of Q4. Dedicated/private attestations will follow as separate artifacts.

Sam: Can we give Sales a single-line status string they can paste in RFPs?

Priya: I'll prepare a one-liner and a short status paragraph. Will post in #sales-ops in 48 hours.

Lina: ISO 27001 question from a partner: are we scoping infrastructure only or also operational processes?

Yara: Scoping includes infrastructure and core ops (change control, incident mgmt). Certification target is next year; final scope to be confirmed after gap assessment next month.

Victor: On VPC/private GA, are we promising per-customer audit exports at GA or will that be a later add-on?

Priya: GA will include per-tenant audit export to customer sinks (S3/GCS) and a streaming option for enterprise. Initial GA window will support JSONL exports and push-based delivery.

Noah: Retention policy question: what will we display in the console vs what can customers store?

Yara: Console view: default 180 days for searchable logs; archived evidence retention for internal support is 12 months. Customers can export and retain logs arbitrarily in their own buckets.

Sam: Is there an API to request historical audit bundles for compliance reviews?

Priya: Yes 180-day live search, plus a historical export API for archived bundles behind a support flow during preview. We'll publish the API spec in docs next week.

Lina: KMS/BYOK: timeline for BYOK + cloud KMS support and HSM?

Yara: Current: managed envelope keys are live. BYOK integration with cloud KMS is planned for preview in ~9 weeks. HSM-backed BYOK with customer-controlled rotation targeted for 4-6 months. Legal & security sign-offs required.

Victor: About rotation: will customers see downtime during key rollover?

Priya: Design approach is dual-wrap and key shadowing to avoid downtime. We'll publish the ops runbook with the preview.

SecurityBot: NOTICE: For any BYOK onboarding we require the BYOK intake form and a short risk assessment: https://redwood.internal/security/forms/byok.

Noah: For SOC2 evidence requests, who do Sales/Support ping for rapid turnaround?

Priya: Primary contacts: Priya and Yara; backup: Victor. We'll provide a redacted evidence pack for routine requests. Enterprise diligence escalations go to Security + Legal.

Sam: Runtime ask: will audit events include model id, region, token counts, and request_id?

Yara: Planned schema will include request_id, model_id, region, timestamps, tokens_in, tokens_out, and latency_ms. Cost attribution fields emitted when available.

Lina: Console features: will there be an admin-level search and export UI?

Priya: Admin search with filters (time range, user_id, model_id, request_id) and CSV/JSON export will be in the GA UX.

Victor: Pen test reports: can customers get full reports?

Yara: We run periodic third-party pen tests. Executive summaries are shareable; full reports require NDA and legal review. We'll add templated request steps to the compliance docs.

Noah: Leadership asks: 1) Priya to post sales blurb in 48h. 2) Yara to publish audit log schema draft in 7 days.

Priya: Acknowledged.

Yara: Acknowledged. I'll ping eng-runtime when draft is live.

SecurityBot: ACTION CREATED: Security board card "all-hands followups: SOC2/ISO/VPC/BYOK" -> https://redwood.internal/projects/security/789.

Noah: If anyone has specific customer evidence requests, drop them here and we'll prioritize. Closing thread after artifacts posted. :thumbsup:

Sam: Thanks, super helpful.

SecurityBot: THREAD CLOSED: follow-ups tracked.
